title: Integral evaluation of the exact derived closed unit
statement: Let A be any commutative ring, i:D→T a closed immersion of schemes, F an A-module sheaf on the small etale site of T, and κ in Ext²(i_*A_D,F). Use the canonical exact-direct-image single comparison, derived adjunction unit, integral generator, and coefficient forgetting of [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary, def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-system]. The integral evaluation of the derived composite u_D followed by κ equals the integral supported unit Z_T→i_*Z_D followed by the supported coefficient generator and the underlying abelian Ext class of κ. This is the displayed equality in the attached Lean statement; no finiteness, Cartier, invertibility or flatness hypothesis on A occurs.

proof.text: Apply the proved generic exact-single unit comparison [lem-asd-derived-single-unit-exact] to the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction. Unfold the generic single-unit composite and the existing concrete unit and constant comparison; their explicit composites coincide definitionally. A closed immersion supplies exactness of direct image. Express the result through Ext.homEquiv.

Forgetting coefficients commutes with the constant unit: evaluate the two adjuncts on each constant integer r. Both give its image r in A on the pulled-back etale object. Apply Ext.homEquiv, functoriality of Ext under exact forgetting, and Yoneda associativity to obtain the displayed equality. Empty schemes and supports are covered by the same functorial identity.

mathlib_searches.results: CategoryTheory.constantPresheafAdj_unit_app; CategoryTheory.constantSheafAdj_counit_app; CategoryTheory.constantSheafΓAdj. These supply constant-adjunction APIs, but not this derived coefficient compatibility.

CategoryTheory.Adjunction.derivedη_fac_app; CategoryTheory.Adjunction.derivedη_fac_app_assoc. These give the derived unit factorization, but still require the exact single and coefficient comparisons.
No hits in Mathlib. Local library search finds the boundary interfaces, boundary existence, Cartier pair pullback and supported-Hom naturality, but no theorem of the three compatibility clauses.

theorem supported_derived_unit_forget (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {D T : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (F : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (κ : Ext ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D)) F 2) :
    (Ext.mk₀ (ordinaryFiniteIntegralGenerator A T)).comp
      ((Ext.homEquiv.symm (supportedDerivedUnit A i ≫ supportedExactDerivedMap
        (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i) (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D) F κ)).mapExactFunctor
          (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget A T)) (zero_add 2) =
    (Ext.mk₀ (supportedIntegralUnit i)).comp
      ((Ext.mk₀ (supportedIntegralGenerator A i)).comp
        (κ.mapExactFunctor (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget A T)) (zero_add 2))
      (zero_add 2)
